(L. also, ‘wind; fight; = कूल; = बल; = निष्प्रयोजन’).

m: स्तभमान mfn. making one's self stiff, behaving arrogantly, assuming an air of authority, AitĀr.
स्तभि m. rigidity, L.
स्तभित mfn. fixed, established, supported, RV.; AV.
स्तभु (see next).
a: स्तभु — n. = स्तंभन q. v.

स्तंभ् — {c1c} A., {c5c} {c9c} P. (स्तंभते, स्तभ्नोति, स्तभ्नाति, स्तांभित or स्तब्धः; the स् of the root being changed to ष् after prepositions ending in इ or उ and also after अव) 1 To stop, hinder, arrest, suppress; कंठः स्तंभितबाष्पवृत्तिकलुषः Ś. 4. 5. --2 To make firm or stiff, to make immovable. --3 To stupefy, paralyze, benumb; प्राणा दध्वंसिरे गात्रं तस्तंभे च हते प्रिये Bk. 14. 55. --4 To prop, support, uphold, sustain. --5 To become stiff, rigid or immovable. --6 To be proud or elated, be stiff-necked. (The following verse illustrates the root in its different conjugations: --स्तंभते पुरुषः प्रायो यौवनेन धनने च . न स्तभ्नाति क्षितीशोऽपि न स्तभ्नोति युवाप्यसौ ..). --Caus. (स्तंभयति-ते). 1 To stop, arrest. --2 To make firm or rigid. --3 To paralyze. --4 To prop, support.

स्तंभः — [स्तंभ्-अच्] 1 Fixedness, stiffness, rigidity, motionlessness; रंभा स्तंभं भजति Vikr. 18. 29; Ki. 12. 28; गात्रस्तंभः स्तनमुकुलयोरुत्प्रबंधः प्रकंपः Māl. 2. 5; तत्संकल्पोपहितजाडिम स्तंभमभ्योति गात्रं 1. 35, 4. 2. --2 Insensibility, stupefaction, stupor, numbness, paralysis. --3 Stoppage, obstruction, hindrance; सोऽ पश्यत्प्रणिधानेन संततेः स्तंभकारणं R. 1. 74; वाक्स्तंभं नाटयति Māl. 8. --4 Restraint, curbing, suppressing; कृतश्चित्तस्तंभः प्रतिहतधियामजंलिरपि Bh. 3. 6. --5 Prop, support, fulcrum. --6 A pillar, column, post. --7 A stem, trunk (of a tree). --8 Stupidity. --9 Absence of feeling or excitability. --10 The suppression of any force or feeling by supernatural or magical means. --Comp. --उत्कीर्ण a. carved out of a post of wood (as a statue). --कर a. {1} paralysing, benumbing. {2} obstructing. --(रः) a fence. --कारणं cause of obstruction or impediment. --पूजा worship of the posts of temporary pavilions erected for marriages or other occasions of solemnity.
स्तंभकिन् — m. A kind of musical instrument covered with leather.

स्तंभनं — [स्तंभयति स्तंभ्-णिच् ल्युट्] 1 Stopping, obstructing, hindering, arresting, suppressing, restraining; लोलोल्लोलक्षुभितकरणोज्जृंभणस्तंभनार्थं U. 3. 36. --2 Paralysing, benumbing, stupefying. --3 Quieting, composure; Pt. 1. 360. --4 Making firm or stiff, fixing firmly. --5 Propping, supporting, --6 Stopping the flow of blood. --7 Anything employed as an astringent. --8 A particular magical art or faculty; see स्तंभ (10). --नः N. of one of the five arrows of Cupid.
स्तंभिन् — a. Supporting, stopping &c.
स्तंभिनी — The Earth(one of the five elements).
स्तंभित — a. 1 Stopped, hindered. --2 Benumbed, paralyzed. --3 Composed, collected; see स्तंभ्.

स्तंबः — [स्था-अबच् किच्च पृषो˚ Uṇ. 4. 96] 1 A clump of grass &c.; R. 5. 15. --2 A sheaf of corn; as in स्तंबकरिता q. v. --3 A cluster, clump or bunch (in general); U. 2. 29, R. 15. 19. --4 A bush, thicket. --5 A shrub or plant having no decided stem. --6 The post to which an elephant is tied. --7 A post. --8 Stupefaction, insensibility; (probably for स्तंभ in these two senses). --9 A mountain. --Comp. --करि a. forming sheaves or clusters. --(रिः) corn, rice. --करिता forming sheaves or clusters, abundant or luxuriant growth; न शालेः स्तंबकरिता बप्तुर्गुणमपेक्षते Mu. 1. 3. --घनः {1} a small hoe for weeding clumps of grass. {2} a sickle for cutting corn. {3} a basket for holding the heads of wild rice. --घ्नः, --घातः --हन्, --हननं --नी a sickle for cutting corn, a hoe. --पुरं N. of a city (ताम्रलिप्त).
स्तंबेरमः — An elephant; स्तंबेरमा मुखरशृंखलकर्षिणस्ते R. 5. 72; Śi. 5. 34; Māl. 9. 33.

m: स्तम्भ् or स्तभ् (connected with √ स्कम्भ्, q.v.; in native lists written स्तन्भ्) cl. 5. 9. P. (Dhātup. xxxi, 7) स्तभ्नोति, स्तभ्नाति (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 82), or cl. 1. Ā. (x, 26) स्तम्भते (pr. p. also स्तम्भत्, Hariv., स्तभमान [q.v.] AitĀr.; pf. तस्तम्भ, ˚म्भत्, तस्तभुः, p. तस्तभ्वस्, ˚वान, RV.; तस्तभान, तस्तम्भे, MBh.; aor. अस्तम्भीत्; अस्ताम्प्सीत्, TBr.; अस्तभत् Gr.; fut. स्तम्भिता, ˚भिष्यति, ib.; inf. स्तब्धुम्, Kathās.; ind.p. स्तब्ध्वा, AV. &c.; स्तम्भित्वा, MBh.; -स्तभ्य and -स्तम्भम्, Br.), to fix firmly, support, sustain, prop (esp. the heavens), RV.; AV.; Br.; to support or hold up by contact with, reach up to (acc.), MBh.; Hariv.; to stop, stop up, arrest, make stiff or immovable, paralyze, RV. &c. &c.; (Ā.) to rest or lean on (loc.), Hcar.; to become stiff or immovable, Bhaṭṭ.; to become solid, MBh. xii, 6807 : Pass. स्तभ्यते (aor. अस्तम्भि), to be firmly fixed or supported or propped &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. स्तभायति, to make firm, support, RV.; to stop, arrest, ib.; स्तम्भयति, ˚ते (aor. अतस्तम्भत्), to fix, establish, erect, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to make stiff or rigid, paralyze, Suśr.; to make solid, ib.; to stop, arrest (also by magic), suppress, check, restrain, ib. : Desid. तिस्तम्भिषति Gr.: Intens. तास्तभ्यते, ib. [cf. Gk. στέμϕυλον, στέμβω, στείβω; Lith. stambras, stimbras; Germ. stampfôn, stampfen; Eng. stamp, stump.]

Impv. स्तनिहि; pf. तस्तान, तस्तनुः Gr.; aor. अस्तानीत्, AV.; fut. स्तनिता, ˚निष्यति Gr.), to resound, reverberate, roar, thunder, RV. &c. &c.; to utter inarticulate sounds, Vās. : Caus. स्तनयति (aor. अतिष्टनत्) id. (स्तनयति, ‘it thunders’), RV. &c. &c.; crackle (as fire), AitBr. : Desid. तिस्तनिषति Gr.: Intens. तंस्तन्यते, तंस्तन्ति, ib. (2. sg. Impv. तंस्तनीहि See अभि-ष्टन्).

puM, (stanyate Sabdyate kAmukEH stanayati kaTayati vakzaHSoBAmiti vA । stana Sabde + GaY .) avayavaviSezaH । mAi iti cU~cI iti ca BAzA ॥ tatparyyAyaH । kucaH 2 । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 77 ॥ kUcaH 3 urojaH 4 vakzojaH 5 payoDaraH 6 vakzoruhaH 7 urasijaH 8 । tasyAgraM cUcukam । iti SabdaratnAvalI । tasya SuBalakzaRaM yaTA, gAruqe । 56 । 95 । “aromaSO stanO pInO GanAvavizamO SuBO । kaWinAvaromamuro mfdugrIvA ca kambuBA ॥” tasya manoharatvakArakOzaDaM yaTA, tatrEva । 194 । 4 । “kuzWanAgabalAcUrRaM navanItasamanvitam । tallepo yuvatInAYca kuryyAnmanoharaM stanam ॥” aDastanarogasya saMprAptimAha । “sakzIrO vApyadugDO vA dozaH prApya stanO striyaH raktaM mAMsaYca saMdUzya stanarogAya kalpyate ॥” adugDAvapi stanO prasUtAyA garBiRyASca striyA bodDavyO । yata Aha suSrutaH “DamanyaH saMvftadvArAH kanyAnAM stanasaMSritAH । dozAvisaraRAstAsAM na Bavanti stanAmayAH ॥” dozAvisaraRAH saMvftadvAratvena dozARAmavisaraRamasaYcAro yAsu tAH । “tAsAmeva prasUtAnAM garBiRInAYca tAH punaH । svaBAvAdeva vivftA jAyante samBavantyataH ॥” * ॥ stanarogARAmatideSena lakzaRAnyAha । “paYcAnAmapi tezAntu hitvA SoRitavidraDim । lakzaRAni samAnAni bAhyavidraDilakzaREH ॥” paYcAnAM vAtapittakaPasannipAtAgantujAnAm । AgantujastanarogABiGAtena Salyena ca bodDavyaH ॥ raktajasyAsamBavaH । svaBAvAt ॥ * ॥ aTa stanarogasya cikitsA । “SoTaM stanotTitamavekzya BizagvidaDyAt yadvidraDAvaBihitaM bahuTA viDAnam । Ame vidAhini taTEva ca tasya pAke tasyAH stanO satatameva ca nirgfhItO ॥ pittaGnAni tu SItAti dravyARyatra prayojayet । jalOkABirharedraktaM na stanAvupanAhayet ॥” upanAhayet svedayet । “lepo viSAlAmUlena hanti pIqAM stanotTitAm । niSAkanakakalkAByAM lepaH proktaH stanArkzihA ॥” viSAlA indravAruRI । kanakasya DattUrasya patraM grAhyam । “lepAnnihanti mUlaM stanarogaM vanDyakarkowyAH । nirvApya taptalohaM salile tadvA pibettatra ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥

m: स्तन m. (or n. g. अर्धर्चादि ifc. आ or ई; derivation doubtful, but prob. connected with √ स्तन्, from the hollow resonance of the human breast), the female breast (either human or animal), teat, dug, udder, RV. &c. &c.

a: स्तनः — [स्तन्-अच्] 1 The female breast; स्तनौ मांसग्रंथी कनककलशावित्युपोमतौ Bh. 3. 20; (दरिद्राणां मनोरथाः) हदयेष्वेव लीयंते विधवास्त्रीस्तनाविव Pt. 2. 91. --2 The nipple of the breast. --3 The breast, udder, or dug of any female animal; अर्धपीतस्तनं मातुरामर्दक्लि ष्टकेशरं Ś. 7. 14. --Comp. --अंशुकं a cloth covering the breasts or bosom, {{breastmantle->breast mantle||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}}. --अग्रः a nipple. --अंगरागः a paint or pigment smeared on the breasts of women. --अंतरं {1} the heart. {2} the space between the breasts; (न) मृणालसूत्रं रचितं रतनांतरे Ś. 6. 17, R. 10. 62. {3} a mark on the breast (said to indicate future widowhood). --आभोगः {1} fulness or expanding of the breasts. {2} the circumference or orb of the breast. {3} a man with large breasts like those of a woman. --तटः, --ष्टं the slope of the breast; cf. तट. --प, --पा, --पायक, --पायिन् a. sucking the breast, a suckling. --पानं sucking of the breast. --भरः {1} the weight or heaviness of breasts; पादाग्रस्थितया मुहुः स्तनभरेणानीतया नम्रतां Ratn. 1. 1. {2} a man having breasts like those of a woman. --भवः a particular position in sexual union. --मुखं, --वृंतं --शिखा a nipple.

m: स्त्री f. (perhaps for सूत्री, or सोत्री, ‘bearer of children’, fr. √ 2. सू; accord. to some connected with Lat. sator; nom. स्त्री; acc. in later language also स्त्रीम् and स्त्रीस् pl.) a woman, female, wife, RV. &c. &c.

v: na॰ striyAH sagrahaRaM yatra । parastrIharaRarUpe vivAdapadamede । tatsvarUpAdika vorami॰ darSitaM yaTA “aTa strIsaMgrahaRAKya vyavahArapadam । tasya trEvivyamAha vfhaspatiH “pApamUlaM saMgrahaRaM triprakAraM niToGata । balopaDikfte dve tu tftIyamanurAgajam” iti । etezAM svarUpaM darSayati sa eva “anicCantyA yat kriyata mattonmattapramatteyA । vilapantyA vA rahasi balAtkArakftantu tat । CadmanA gfhamAnIya dattvA svaM madakAraRam । saMyogaH kriyate yatra tacUpaDikftaM viduH । anyonyaYcakzUrAgeRa dUtIsaMprezaRena vA । kftaM rUpArTaloBena jYeyaM tadanurAgajam” iti । anurAgaja saMgrahasya triviDatvaM darSayati sa eva “tatpunastriviDaM proktaM praTamaM maDyamottamam” iti । vyAso'pi “saMgrahastriviDojYeyaH praTamomaDyamastaTA । uttamaSceti SAstrezu lakzaRaM ca pfTak pfTaka” iti । etezAM svarUpamAhaturvyAsavfhaspatI “kawAkzAvekzaRaM hAsyaM dUtIsaMprezaRaM taTA । sparSoBazaRavastrARAM praTamaH saMgrahaH smftaH । prezaRaM ganDamAlyAnAM PalaDUpAnnavAsasAm । samBAzaRaYca rahasi maDyamaM saMgrahaM viduH । ekaSayyAsanaM krIqA cumbanAliNganaM taTA । etat saMgrahaRaM proktamuttamaM SAstravediBiH” iti । strIsaMgrahaRasya jYAnopAyamAha yAjYavalkyaH “pumAn saMgrahaRe grAhyaH keSAkeSi parastriyA । sadyo vA kAmajEScihnEH pratipattO dvayostaTA” iti । paraBAryayA sada keSAkeSi krIqanena sadyaH aBinavEH kAmajEH kararuhadaSanAdikftavraRAdiliNgErdvayoH sampratipattAvayaM strIsagrahaRavAn iti pratipattavya ityarTaH । upAyAntaramAha sa eva “nIvIstanaprAvaraRasakTikeSAvamarSanam । adeSakAla samBAzaH sahEkasTAnameva ca” iti । kurvARa iti SezaH sakTi UruH । manurapi “striyaM spfSedadeSe yaH spfzwo vA marzayet tayA । parasparasyAnumate sarvaM saMgrahaRaM smftam” । yastu darpAdinA mayeyaM Bukteti vadati so'pi taTAviGatvena grAhya ityAhaturmanunAradO “darpAdvA yadi vA mohAt SlAGayA vA svayaM vadet । pUrvaM mayeyaM Bukteti tacca saMgrahaRaM smftam” iti । balAtkArakftasya strIsaMgrahaRasya sAhasAntarBUtatvena tatrEva darSitatvAdupaDikfta daRqamAha vfhampatiH “darpAnnA kAmayedyastu tasya sarvaharodamaH । aNkayitvA BagANkena purAnnirvAsayettataH” iti । sarvaharaH sarvasvaharaH etat sajAtIya vizayam । hInotakfzwAgamane tu krameRArdDaM DanaM sarvasvaharaRarUpo baDasahitasarvasvaharaRarUpo vya daRqA'vagantavyaH । “damAneyaH samAyAntriti” sAhagavAdanirUpaRadarSitavacanAt । tatra vacane puruzasyApakarzABAve yuko daRqA na striyA iti noktastasyAH daRqaH tena sADasa strAsaMgrahaRavat prakfta'pi sajAtIyApaBuktAyAH savyavahAryyAvyAH prAyaScittAcaraRAnantaraM punarapi tenopaBuktAyA iti jYAtavyamityuktaM madanaratne । anurAgajatriviGa sagrahaRe daRqamAhA sa eva “trayARAmapi cEtezAM praTamo maDyamottamO । vinayaH kalpanIyaH syAdADakodradiRADikaH” iti । aDikaH praTamasAhasAdiByA'DikaH । samBoge daRqamAha yAjYavalkyaH “svajAtAvuttamo daRqa Anulomye tu maDyamaH । prAtilomye baDaH puMmo nAryAH” karRAdikarttanam” iti । caturRAmapi varRAnAM balAtkAreRa sajAtoyaparaBAryAvamane sASItipaRasahasno daRqaH । yadA tvAnulomyena hInajAtIyAgamanaM tadA maDyamamAhasaH । utakfzwajAtIyAgamane ganturbaDaH । tasyAH karRAdikarttanamityarTaH । etaccAnurAgajagrahaRavizayaM striyA api daRqABiDAnAt । valAtkAropaDikftayostu striyA anaparADatvena daRqABAvAt । asmAdeva prAtilomyena gamane puruzasya baGaM viDAya striyAstadardDatulyakarRanAsAdikarttanaviDAnAt sajAtIyAgamane puruzasya yAvuktAvuttamamaDyaBasAhasO daRqO tadardDaM striyAdaRqa iti sUcitam । ataeva kAtyAyanaH “sarvezu cAparADezu puMsohyarTadamastaTA । tadardDaM yozitA dadyurbaDe pu so'Ngakarttanam” । iti । striyA iti SezaH । yadA punaH savarRAmaguptAM Anulomyena guptAM vA vrajati tadA viSezamAha manuH “sahasraM vrAhmaRo daRqyo'guptAM viprAM balAd vrajan । SatAni paYca daRqyaH syAdicCantyA saMha saNgataH । sahasraM brahmaRI daRqaM dApyo gupte tu te vrajan । SUdrAyAM kzatrayaviSoH sahasrantu BaveddamaH” iti । te kzatriyavESye । etacca gurusaKiBAryyAdivyAtiriktavizayam । tatra daRqAntaraviDAnAt । tadAha nAradaH “mAtA mAtfzvasA SvaSrUrmAtulAnI pitfzvasA । pivavyasaKiSizyastrI BaginI tatsaKI snuzA । duhitA cAryaBAryyA ca sagotrA SaraRAgatA । rAjYI pravrajitA DAtrI sADvI varRottamA ca yA । SiSnasyotkarttanAttatra nAnyodaRqo viDIyate” iti । yattu prAtilomyena gamane kzatriyAdeH puruzasya vaDa ityuktaM yogoSvaravacane । tadguptAvizayamanyaTA'rTadaRqaH । taTA ca manuH “uBAvapi hi tAveva brAhmaRyA guptayA saha । viplutO SfdravaddaRqyO dagDavyO vA kawAgninA । brahmaRIM yadyaguptAntu sevetAM vESya pArTivO । vESyampaYcaSata kuryyAt kzAtrayantu sahasniRam” iti । paYcaSatampaRaSatapaYcakadaRqaBAjamityarTaH । eva sahasriRamityatrApi । kzatriyasya guptavESyAgamane vESyamya ca guptakzatriyAgamane krameRa paRasahasrapaRaSatapaYcakaM tayordaRqa ityAha sa eva “vESyaScet kzatriyANguptAM vESyAM vA kzatriyo vrajet । yo brAhmaRyAmaguptAyAntA vuBO daRqamahetaH” iti । SUdrasyAguptotkfzwastrIgamane liNgacCedanasarvasvApaharaRe guptAgamane tu baDasarvasvApa hArO । taTA ca sa eva “SUdro guptamaguptaM vA dvEjAtaM varRamAcaran । aguptEkANgasarvasvo guptO sarveRa hIyate” iti । ayaYca baDAdyupadeSaH prajApAlanADikArAdrAjYa eva na dvijAtimAtrasya । “vrAhmaRaH parIkzArTamapi SastraM nAdadIteti” SastragrahaRasya nizidDatvAt । yadA tu rAjYo nivedane kAlavilambena kAryyAtipAtastadA dvijAtimAtrasyApi SastragrahaRe'DikAro'styeva “SastraM dvijAtiBirgrAhyaM Darmo yatroparuDyate । nAtatAyibaDe dozo hanturBavati kaScana । pracCannaM vA prakASaM vA manyusta manyumfcCati” iti Sastra grahaRAByanujYAnAt । parastriyA saha samBazaRa karturdaRqamAha manuH “parasya patnyA puruzaH saMlApaM yojayet sUha । pUrvamAkzArito dozEH prApnuyAt pUrvasAhasam” iti । AkzAritaH aBiSastaH । dorzaH nAnAstyupamogavAYCABiH । pApabudDyA yaH samBAzaRaM karoti tadvizayametat । ataeva “yastvanAkzAritaH parvamaBiBAzeta kAraRAt । na dozaM prApnuyAt kiYcinna hi tasya vyatikramaH” iti । manuvfhaspatyuktapUrvasAhasa maDyamasAhasayorutkfzwasajAtIyAsamBAzaRAdivizayatvena vyavasTA parikalpanIyA । parapuruzeRa saha pitrAdiBiH rnizidDaM samBAzaRaM yA karoti sA paRaSataM daRqyA parastriyA saha pitrAdiBirnizidDasamBAzaRaM yaH puruzaH karoti paRaSatadvayaM daRqanIyaH । dvayorapi nizidDaparasparasamBAzaRAdi kurvatoH samBoge yo daRqaH sa eva daRqa ityAha yAjYavalkyaH “strI nizeDe SataM zwadyAd dviSatantu damaM pumAn । pratizeDe tayordaRqo yaTA saN grahaRe taTA” iti । niziDyata iti nizeDaH karBaRi halaSceti GaY । cAraRAdistrIvyatiriktavipayametat “nEza cAraRadarerzu viDirnAtmopajIvizu । sajjayanti hi te nArIrnigUQAScArayanti ca” iti manusmaraRAt nawAH AtmopajIvinaH veSopajIvinaH । etezA dArazu eza viDina aBiBAzaRAdinimittakadaRqaviDirna । paranare nArIH svaBAryyAH sajjayanti puruzAntare saMyojanti pracCannIkftya cArayanti vetyarTaH । mADAraRastrIgamane daRqamAha yAjYavalkyaH “avarudvAsu dAsIzu BujizyAsu taTEva ca । gamyAsvapi pumAndApyaH paYcASatpaRikandamam” iti । svAminA yA SuSrUzArTaM gfhe eva sTAtavyamityeva puruzAntaropaBAgato nirudDAstAH avarudDAH । puruzAntareRAvaruDya BujyamAnA BujajizyAH yA dAsyo BujizyA avarudDA vA tAsu sarvapuruzagamyAsvapi gamane paYcASatpaRaM daRqyaH tAmAmparaparigfhItatvena parastrItulyatvAt । caSabdAdveSyAsvariRInAmapi grahaRam । tAsvapi sarvapuruzasADAraRIsu paraparigfhItAsu gamane'yameva daRqa iti mantavyam etadavABipretyAha nArado'pi “svEriRqabrAhmaRI veSyA dAsO nizkAsinI ca yA । gamyAH syurAnulomyena striyo na pratilomataH । Asveva tu BujizyAsu dozaH myAtpAdAravat । gamyAsvapi hi nopeyAdyattAH paraparigrahAH” iti । abrAhmaRIti svEriRyApiSezaRam । svEriRI svatantrA puMScalI । nizkAsinI kuwumbAnnirgateti madanaratne । svAmyanavarudDA dAsIti vijYAneSvaramADavAcAryyapraBftayaH । BujizyA svA sveti sambanDaH । vyAso'pi “paroparudDAgamane paYcASatpaRiko damaH । prashya veSyAgamane daRqo daSapaRaH smftaH” iti । pramahya vetanadAnaM vinA atrAnavarudDAsu peSyAdipu gamyatvABiDAnanna pApABAvapratipAdanArTaM kintu rAjadaRqABAvapratipAdanArTam । “paSuveTyAdisamane prAjApatyaM viDIyate” ityAdivacanEH prAyaTittasyaraRAt । balAtkAreRa anavarudDadAsyaBigamane daRqamAha yAjYavalkyaH “prasahya dAsyaBigame daRqo daSapasaH smftaH । vahUnAM yadyakAmAsO caturviMSatikaH puTak” iti । puruzasamBogajIvikAsu dAsIzu svEriRyAdizu SulkadAnamantareRa valAtkAreRAmigacCato daSapaRo daRqaH । yadyanicCantImekAmbalAtkAreRa bahavo gavarvAnta tarhi pratyekaM caturviSatipaRAtmako daRqa ittyarTaH । yadi punaH sA svecCayA BAwakaM gfhItvA paScAnnecCati tadA balAdvrajatAmapi bahUnAmadozaH yadi tasyA vyADyAdyaBiBavo na Bavet । ataeva nAradaH “vyADitA saSramA vyagrA rAjakarmaparAyaRA । AmantritA cennAgacCedadaRqyA baqavA smftA” iti । pAradArya prasaNgAt kanyAyAmapi daRqamAha yAjYavalkyaH “alaNkftAM haran kanyAmuttamaM tvanyaTA'Damam । daRqaM dadyAt savarRAsu pratilomye baDaH smftaH” iti । alaNkftAM vivAhABimuKIM tAM savarRAM kanyAmapaharan uttama sAhasaM daRqanIyaH । tadanaBimuKIM haran praTamasAha sam । utkfzwavarRajAtAM harataH kzatriyAdebaDa ityarTaH । Anulomyena--sakAmAharaRe na daRqastaTA ca sa eva “sakAmAsvanulomAsu na dozastvanyaTA damaH” iti । kanyAdUzaRe daRqamAha sa eva “dUzaRe tu karacCeda uttamAyAM baDaH smftaH । SataM strIdUzaRe dadyAt dve tu miTyABiSaMsane” iti । “paSUn gacCan SataM dApyo hInAM strINgAYca maDyamam” iti । yadyakAmAM kanyAnnaKakzatAdinA prasahya dUzayati tadA karacCedaH । yadA tu aNguli prakzepeRa tAmeva yonikzatAM kurvan dUzayati tadA viSezamAha manuH “aBizahya tu yaH kanyAM kuryyAddarpeRa mAnavaH । tasyASu karttye aNgulyO daRqaYcArhati zaw Satama” iti । sakAmadUzaRe'pyAha sa eva “sakAmAM dUzayan kanyAM nANgulicCedamarhati । dviSataM tu damaM dApyaH prasaNgavinivfttaye” iti । yadA kanyA vidagDA vA kanyAM dUzayati tadApyAha sa eva “kanyEva kanyAM yA kuryyAttasyAstu dviSato damaH । yA tu kanyAM prakuryyAt strI sA sadyo mORqyaBarhati । aNgulyoreva vA CedaH KareRodvahanantaTA” iti kuryyAt yonikzatavatImiti SezaH । yadA punarutkfzwajAtIyAM kanyAM sakAmAmakAmAM vABigacCati tadA hInasya kzatriyAderbaDaH । yadA sakAmAM savarRAmaBigacCati tadA SulkaM gomiTunaM tatpitre dadyAt । anicCati tasmin daRqarUpeRa rAjYe dadyAt । savarRAmakAmANgacCato baDa eva । tadAha manuH “uttamAM savamAnastu jaGanyobarDamarhati । SulkaM dadyAt savamAnaH samAmicCet pitA yadi । yo'kAmAM dUzayet kanyAM sa sadyo vaDamarhati । sakAmAM dUzayaM stulyo na baDaM prApnuyAnnaraH” iti । cARqAlyAdigamane daRqamAha yAjYavalkyaH “antyABigamane tvaNkyaM kubarRena pravAsayet । SUdrastaTAntya pava syAdantyasyAryAgame baDaH” iti । antyA cARqAlI tadgamane trabarRikAn prAyaScittAnaBimuKAn “sahasraM trantyO । 1 yamiti” manuvacanAnusAreRa paRasahasraM daRqayitvA kutsitavarRene BAgAkAreRANkayitvA svarAzwrAnnirvAsayet SUdraH punaScARqAlINgacCaScaRqAla eva । aNkya eveti mADavIye pAWaH । cARqAlasya tUtkfzwajAtistryABigamane baDa evetyarTaH । yonivyatirikta sTale gacCato daRqamAha sa eva “ayonO gacCato yozAM puruzaM vA'BimehataH । caturviMSatiko daRqastaTA pravrajitAgame” iti । yastu yozAM muKAdAvaBigacCati puruzaM vaBimuKaM mehati taTA pravrajatAM vA gaccahati asO caturviMSatipaRA daRqanIya ityarTaH । strIkfte saMgrahaRe daRqamAha vfhaspatiH “gfhamAgatya yA nArI praloBya sparSanAdinA । kAmayet tatra sA daRqyA narasyArdDadamaH smfta” iti vacasA striyaM praloBya gacCataH puruzasya yo daRqastadardDaM daRqyA” ।

1. स्तु cl. 2. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiv, 34; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 95) स्तौति or स्तवीति, स्तुते or स्तुवीते (in RV. also स्तवते, 3. sg. स्तवे [with pass. sense], 1. 3. sg. स्तुषे, Impv. स्तोषि, p. [mostly with pass. sense] स्तुवान, स्तवान or स्तवान, स्तवमान; in BhP. स्तुन्वन्ति, in Up. p. स्तुन्वान; pf. तुष्टाव, तुष्टुवुस्, तुष्टुवे, RV. &c. &c.; aor. अस्तावीत् or अस्तौषीत्, Br. &c.; स्तोषत्, स्तोषाणि, RV.; अस्तोष्ट, ib. &c.; Prec. स्तूयात् Gr.; fut. स्तविता or स्तोता, Vop.; fut. स्तविष्यति, ˚ते, RV.; स्तोष्यति, ˚ते, Br. &c.; Cond. अस्तोष्यत्, Bhaṭṭ.; inf. स्तोतुम्, ib. &c.; स्तवितुम्, Vop.; स्तोतवे, स्तवध्यै, RV.; ind.p. स्तुत्वा, AV. &c.; -स्तुत्य, Br. &c.; -स्तूय, MBh. &c.), to praise, laud, eulogize, extol, celebrate in song or hymns (in ritual, ‘to chant’, with loc. of the text from which the Sāman comes), RV. &c. &c.: Pass. स्तूयते (aor. अस्तावि), to be praised or celebrated; स्तूयमान, mfn. being praised, ib. : Caus. स्तावयति or स्तवयति (aor. अतुष्टवत्, RV.; ˚टुवत्, JaimBr.), to praise, celebrate; (स्तावयते), to cause to praise or celebrate, BhP. : Desid. तुष्टूषति, ˚ते (p.p. तुष्टूषित), to wish to celebrate, Śaṃk. : Intens. तोष्टूयते, तोष्टोति Gr.
2. स्तु. See सु-ष्टु p. 1238, col. 1.

a: स्तु — {c2c} U. (स्तौति-स्तवीति, स्तुते-स्तुवीते; तुष्टाव-तुष्टुवे, अस्तावीत्-अस्तोष्ट, स्तोष्यति-ते, स्तोतुं, स्तुत; desid. तुष्टूषति-ते; the स् of स्तु is changed to ष् after a preposition ending in इ or उ) 1 To praise, laud, eulogize, extol, glorify, celebrate; Bv. 1. 41; Mu. 3. 16; Bk. 8. 92, 15. 70, 3. --2 To celebrate or praise in song, to hymn, worship by hymns.

Ā. -स्तुभान, RV.; Gr. also pf. तुष्टुभे; fut. स्तोभिता &c.), to utter a joyful sound, hum, make a succession of exclamations, shout (esp. applied to the chanted interjections in a Sāman), RV.; Br.; Lāṭy.; cl. 1. [स्तु-क्तिन्] 1 Praise, eulogy, commendation, laudation, स्तुतिभ्यो व्यतिरिच्यंते दूराणि चरितानि ते R. 10. 30. --2 A hymn of praise, panegyric; R. 4. 6. --3 Adulation; flattery, empty or false praise; भूतार्थव्याहृतिः सा हि न स्तुतिः परमोष्ठिनः R. 10. 33. --4 N. of Durgā. --Comp. --गीतं a panegyric, hymn. --पदं an object of praise. --पाठकः a panegyrist, an encomiast, a minstrel, bard, herald. --वादः a laudatory speech, panegyric. --व्रतः a bard.

m: स्तुति—भाग m. N. of wk.
स्तुति—शील mfn. skilful in praise (v.l. श्रुति-श्˚), R.
स्तुति—शब्द m. a word of praise, R.
स्तुति—शस्त्र w.r. for स्तुत-श्˚ (q.v.)
स्तुति—ब्राह्मण N. of wk. (or of a man), Buddh.
स्तुति—चन्द्रिका f. N. of wk.
स्तुति—गीतक n. a song of praise, panegyric, Kathās.
स्तुति—कुसुमाञ्जलि m. ‘handful of flowers’, N. of a poem in praise of Śiva.
स्तुति—मङ्गल n. pl. praises and benedictions, Hariv.
स्तुति—मन्त्र m. a song or hymn of pr˚, VarYogay.
स्तुति—मत् mfn. possessing or knowing hymns of pr˚, ib.

k.v: वैतालिका बोधकराश्चाक्रिका घाण्टिकार्थकाः। स्युर्मागधास्तु मगधा बन्दिनः स्तुतिपाठकाः॥

स्तुति—प्रिय mfn. fond of praise, MW.
स्तुति—सार m. N. of wk.
स्तुति—सूक्ति-माला f. N. of wk.
स्तुति—वाद m. (MW.) laudatory speech, eulogy.
स्तुति—वचन n. (Pañcat.) laudatory speech, eulogy.
स्तुति—वचस् n. (Śiś.) laudatory speech, eulogy.

स्तुति—टीका f. N. of wk.
स्तुत्या (आ), f. a partic. fragrant bark, L.
alum-slate, L.

m: स्तुत्य mfn. to be praised, laudable, praiseworthy, MBh.; R. &c.
a: स्तुत्य — a. Laudable, commendable, praiseworthy; R. 4. 6.

m: स्तुत्य—त्व n. praise worthiness, Sāy.
स्तुत्य—व्रत m. N. of a son of Hiraṇya-retas and the Varṣa ruled by him, BhP.
स्तुवान mfn. praising (Sāy. ‘being praised’). See root, col. 1.
स्तुव m. or n. (?) a partic. part of the head of a horse, L.
स्तुवत् mfn. (pr.p.) praising &c.
स्तुवत् m. a praiser, worshipper, RV.
स्तुवेय, स्तुषेय्य. See p. 1259.

a sacrifice, L.

m: स्त्यान mfn. grown dense, coagulated, Suśr.; Sāh.
stiffened, become rigid, Car.
soft, bland, unctuous, smooth (= स्निग्ध), L.
thick, bulky, gross, W.
sounding, MW.
स्त्यान n. (only L.) density, thickness, grossness, massiveness
unctuousness
nectar
idleness, sloth, apathy
echo, sound.
a: स्त्यान — a. [स्त्यै-क्त] 1 Collected into a mass; Māl. 5. 11, Ve. 1. 21. --2 Thick, bulky, gross. --3 Soft, bland, smooth, unctuous. --4 Sounding. --नं 1 Thickness, grossness, increase in magnitude or bulk; दधति कुहरभाजामत्र भल्लूकयूनामनुरसितगुरूणि स्त्यानमंबू कृतानि Māl. 9. 6; U. 2. 21, Mv. 5. 41. --2 Unctuousness. --3 Nectar. --4 Sloth, idleness. --5 Echo, sound.

m: स्त्याय See सं-स्त्याय.
स्त्यायन n. collecting into a mass, aggregation, crowding together, Nir.
a: स्त्यायनं — Collecting into a mass, crowding together, aggregation.

s: saMhatO । DvanO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvApara॰-aka॰-aniw .) dantyAdirantaH sTAdyayuktatamaDyaH । styAyati tistyAsati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: sahatO DvanO BvA॰ aka॰ aniw । styAyati astyAsIt paryyudAsAnna zopadeSaH ।
m: स्त्यै cl. 1. P. स्त्यायति, to be collected into a heap or mass, Dhātup. xxii, 14; to spread about, ib.; to sound, ib.; cl. 1. Ā. स्त्यायते (pr. p. स्त्यान, q.v.; ind.p. -स्त्याय; see नि-ष्ट्यै), to stiffen, grow dense, increase, Uttarar.; Mcar.
a: स्त्यै — {c1c} U. (स्त्यायति-ते) 1 To be collected into a heap or mass. --2 To spread about, be diffused; शिशिरकदुकषायः स्त्यायते सल्लकीनां Māl. 9. 6, 2. 21; Mv. 5. 41. --3 Sound, echo.

m: स्त्यैन m. a thief, robber, L.

nectar (in this sense prob. fr. √ स्त्यै), L.
